description: This file defines classes and enums related to process information management, including process memory stats, process iteration, process control, and process tree structures within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including memory stats, priority, policy, and control methods.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived class providing information and control over the current process.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a tree of processes, allowing containment checks and retrieval of process IDs.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for managing process memory statistics.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for iterating over processes based on various criteria.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Collects memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Returns the Unique Set Size memory metric.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Returns the Proportional Set Size memory metric.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Returns the Resident Set Size memory metric.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Returns the Virtual Set Size memory metric.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current process iterator is valid.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the process iterator to the next process.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the process iterator to the previous process.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current process information in the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of processes in the iterator.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the process ID.

methods.name: Children
methods.description: Returns an iterator over child processes.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Gets or sets the process priority.

methods.name: Policy
methods.description: Gets or sets the scheduling policy.

methods.name: OOMAdjust
methods.description: Gets or sets the Out-Of-Memory adjustment value.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is active.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Updates memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Memory metric: Unique Set Size.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Memory metric: Proportional Set Size.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Memory metric: Resident Set Size.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Memory metric: Virtual Set Size.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Returns the total allocated memory of the process.

methods.name: Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident memory of the process.

methods.name: Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory of the process.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Gets or sets the process name.

methods.name: Executable
methods.description: Returns the executable path of the process.

methods.name: CommandLine
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments of the process.

methods.name: FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes by name and populates a list.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Triggers a dump signal for the process.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets or sets the user associated with the process.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets or sets the group associated with the process.

methods.name: ContainsProcess
methods.description: Checks if a process ID is contained within the process tree.

methods.name: GetProcessIds
methods.description: Retrieves process IDs within the process tree.

methods.name: RootId
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the process tree.
